questions.question: What is the equation of the line perpendicular to the line 5x + 3y = 6 and having Y-intercept -3?
questions.solution:
We know that: the product of the slope of 2 perpendicular lines is -1.

Let the slope of required equation be m

⇒ m × (-5/3) = -1

⇒ m = 3/5

**Given:** y-intercept = -3

So, equation of line: y = mx + c

⇒ y = 3x/5 - 3

Multiplying equation by 5

⇒ 5y = 3x - 15

questions.question: D and E are points on side AB and AC of ΔABC. DE is parallel to BC. If AD : DB = 2 : 5 and area of ΔADE is 8 cm sq, what is the area (in sq cm) of quadrilateral BDEC?
questions.solution:
Here ΔADE and ΔABC are similar triangles

Given: AD/AB = 2/7

So, DE/BC = 2/7

Let DE be 2b. Then, BC will be 7b

Make an altitude from A on BC and mark the points P and R when it cuts DE and BC respectively.

So, ΔAPD and ΔARB are also similar triangles

⇒ AP/AR = 2/7

Let AP be 2b. Then, AR will be 7b

Since,

Area of ΔADE = 1/2 × 2a × 2b = 2ab

Area of ΔABC = 1/2 × 7a × 7b = 49ab/2

So, area of quadrilateral BDEC = 49ab/2 - 2ab = 45ab/2

∴ Required area = 45ab/2 × (8/2ab) = 90 cm²

questions.question: The average of four consecutive odd numbers is 64. What is the value of largest number?
questions.solution:
Let the 4 numbers be (a - 3), (a - 1), (a + 1) and (a + 3)

So, the sum of these 4 numbers = 4a/4 = 64

⇒ a = 64

∴ Largest number = a + 3 = 64 + 3 = 67

questions.question: Sum of twice a fraction and 3 times its reciprocal is 29/3. What is the fraction?
questions.solution:
Let the fraction be a

⇒ 2a + 3/a = 29/3

⇒ 2a² - 29a/3 + 3 = 0

Multiplying above equation by 3

⇒ 6a² - 29a + 9 = 0

⇒ 6a² - 2a - 27a + 9 = 0

⇒ 2a(3a - 1) - 9(3a - 1) = 0

⇒ (2a - 9)(3a - 1) = 0

∴ a = 9/2, 1/3

questions.question: The distance between the points (2, 7) and (k, -5) is 13. What is the value of k?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distance between the two points = 13

**Formulae used:**

Distance between 2 points = √{[(x₂ - x₁)²] + [(y₂ - y₁)²]}

**Calculations:**

According to question

(x₁,y₁) = (2, 7)

(x₂,y₂) = (k, -5) 

⇒ 13 = √{[(k - 2)²] + [(-5 - 7)²]}

⇒ 13 = √{[k² + 4 - 4k] + [144]}

⇒ 13 = √{k² - 4k + 148}

Squaring both sides

⇒ 169 = k² - 4k + 148

⇒ k² - 4k - 21 = 0

⇒ k² - 7k + 3k - 21 = 0

⇒ k(k - 7) + 3(k - 7) = 0

⇒ (k + 3)(k - 7) = 0

∴ k = -3,

questions.question: A Rs. 100 shirt is offered at 10% discount and a Rs. 300 pair of trousers at 20% discount. If Pritam bought 1 shirt and 3 pairs of trousers, what is the effective discount (in %) he got?
questions.solution:
**Formula used:**

Discount = Marked Price - Selling price

Discount% = [(Marked Price - Selling price)/Marked price]× 100

**Calculation:**

Discount for one shirt = 100(10/100) = Rs 10

Discount for 3 pairs of trousers = 3 × 300(20/100) = Rs 180

Total discount = 10 + 180 = Rs 190

Total cost = 100 + 3 × 300 = 1000

For Rs 1000 he gets a discount of Rs 190

Effective discount % = 100 x (190 / 1000) = 19

∴ ∴ Total discount percentage = 19%

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**

Total cost price of shirts and trousers = 100 × 1 + 300 × 3 = ₹1000

Discunted price for shirt = 100 × 90/100 = ₹90

Discounted price of trousers = 300 × 80/100 = ₹240

Total discounted price of trousers = 3 × 240 = ₹720

Total price paid = 90 + 720 = ₹810

Total discount = 1000 - 810 = 190

∴ Total discount percentage = 190/1000 × 100 = 19

What is the reflection of the point (4, -3) in the line y = -2?
questions.solution:
To find: reflection of the point (4 , -3) in the line y = -2

The equation of line is: y + 2 = 0

The formula for finding the image of a point (x₁,y₁) to the line ax + by + c = 0 is given by:

(x - x₁)/a = (y - y₁)/b = - 2(ax₁ + by₁ + c)/(a² + b²)

Here, a = 0, b = 1 and c = 2

So, we have

(y + 3)/(1) = -2(-3 + 2)/(1) and (x - 4) = 0

⇒ y + 3 = 2 and x = 4

∴ y = -1 and x = 4

questions.question: If sec θ = 13/12, then what is the value of sin θ?
questions.solution:
Given: secθ = 13/12

⇒ secθ = 1/cosθ

⇒ cosθ = 12/13

We know that: sin²θ + cos²θ = 1

⇒ sin²θ + (12/13)² = 1

⇒ sin²θ = 1 - 144/169

⇒ sin²θ = (169 - 144)/169

⇒ sinθ = √(25/169)

∴ sinθ = 5/13

questions.question: A and B together do a job in 6.75 days and A could do the job in 9 days if he worked alone. How many days would B take to do the job if he worked alone?
questions.solution:
Let the total work be a

Work done by A in 1 day = a/9

Work done by A and B in 1 day = a/6.75

Let the work done by B in 1 day be b

Work done by B in 1 day = a/6.75 - a/9

⇒ Work done by B in 1 day = 4a/27 - 3a/27= a/27

∴ Total days taken by B to complete the work = a/(a/27) = 27

questions.question: If a wholesaler, sells a box of chocolates at Rs. 960 he gains 20%. Now if he decides to sell it at Rs. 1120, what is his profit percentage?
questions.solution:
Selling price of a box of chocolates = Rs. 960

Discount = 20%

So, cost price = 960/(1 + 20/100) = Rs 800

New selling price = Rs. 1120

∴ New profit % = [(1120 - 800)/800] × 100 = 32000/800 = 40%

questions.question: The 7th and 12th term of an arithmetic progression are -15 and 5 respectively. What is the 16th term?
questions.solution:
Let the first term of A.P. be a and let the difference be d

⇒ a + 6d = -15 ----(i)

⇒ a + 11d = 5 ----(ii)

Subtracting (i) from (ii)

⇒ 5d = 20

⇒ d = 4

Putting the value of d in (i)

⇒ a + 6 × 4 = -15

⇒ a = -15 - 24 = -39

So, 16th term = a + 15d = -39 + 15 × 4 = -39 + 60 = 21

questions.solution:

Surface area of sphere = 154 cm²

questions.question: What is the LCM of 64 and 56?
questions.solution:
Prime factorization of 64 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 2

Prime factorization of 56 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 7

We can take 2 × 2 × 2 i.e., 8 as common

So, Required LCM = 8 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 7 = 448

questions.question: If a - b = 4 and ab = -3, then what is the value of a³ - b³?
questions.solution:
We know that: (a - b)³ = a³ - b³ - 3ab(a - b)

Given: a - b = 4 and ab = -3

Putting these equations in the above identity

⇒ 4³ = a³ - b³ - 3(-3)(4)

⇒ 64 = a³ - b³ + 36

∴ a³ - b³ = 64 - 36 = 28
